The '''Shasa system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Shasa ale]].<ref name="FarOrbit">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Preparing for War}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Shasa ale]]|system=Shasa [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shasa [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-12.<ref name="TEA" />
